title: Speaking — Deciding what to buy
description: Part 1 interview, a cue card and a Part 3 discussion on deciding what to buy.

questions: Which season do you most look forward to?
Does the time of year affect what you wear?
What do you like doing in cooler weather?
Has the weather in your area changed since you were a child?
What makes you trust a product recommendation?
Do you ever wait before making a purchase?

part2.topic: Describe a time you changed your mind before buying something.
points: what you decided to do instead
part2.closing: and explain why you were pleased or disappointed with your decision.

questions: How can online reviews support sensible decisions without misleading shoppers?
What should shops be required to disclose about sponsored recommendations?
What differences would you expect between a large city and a small town in relation to deciding what to buy?
